Usage: ai-bdd run [options] [selectors...]

run scenarios; the first run characterizes, later runs replay recordings

Arguments:
  selectors                scenario ids, id prefixes, or doc globs

Options:
  --tag <tags>             only scenarios with any of these tags
                           (comma-separated or repeatable)
  --grep <text>            only scenarios whose title contains this text
                           (case-insensitive)
  --driver <name>          driver to use (overrides defaultDriver)
  --frozen                 fail with exit 4 instead of compiling when a plan is
                           stale (default when CI=1)
  --no-compile             do not compile stale docs before running
  --strict                 fail healed steps (REPLAY_DIVERGED)
  -u, --update-recordings  re-characterize and overwrite recordings
  --no-agent               fail any step that needs the agent (ACT_NO_AGENT)
  --audit                  re-run the judge next to deterministic checks and
                           fail on disagreement
  --workers <n>            number of scenarios to run in parallel
  --reporter <names>       reporters to run: json, junit, markdown
                           (comma-separated or repeatable)
  -h, --help               display help for command
